sameInputCheck.rule: every provider output records the SHA-256 of the frame PNG it read (the refiner also its SCV-LINES file, MobileSAM also its prompt meta; the fusion replay the frame PNG and every observation file); score.py asserts each against the frame meta / the current file and stops on any mismatch (post-review B5)

truthBufferFragility.rule: u = the house's largest stated vertex uncertainty (truth/real/<house>.json vertexUncertaintyPx); the exterior is buffered by -u and +u px with mitred joins and the opening runs move with their face (score.py buffer_truth); exclusions and bodies stay as drawn. A conclusion is FRAGILE when it is not the same at -u, 0 and +u; an IoU difference under 0.0005 is a tie and counts as FRAGILE.
